title: Battle of the Trough
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Trough", at revision 1374571289, opens: "The Battle of the Trough was a skirmish of the early French and Indian War (1754–63) fought between Native Americans and Anglo-American settlers in the valley of the South Branch Potomac River in what is now northern Hardy County, West Virginia, USA." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4873031, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1756 skirmish in the French and Indian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
